title: Gospel reading lab
subtitle: Produce a defended first reading of a short scene.
overview: A reading lab asks for evidence, not speed: list finite verbs, identify dependent forms, map connectors, and give a literal first translation.
Only after the map is complete should you rewrite the English for fluency. Keep an uncertainty note where more context is needed.

items.grc: καὶ ἐξελθὼν εἶδεν πολὺν ὄχλον καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς.
items.en: And going out, he saw a large crowd and was moved with compassion for them.
And he began to teach them many things.
